corrected_content.problem:
Find the Cartesian equation of the curve defined parametrically by
$$
\displaystyle x = t - 2, y = t^{2}, t ∈ (- ∞, ∞).
$$
corrected_content.worked_solution: From $x=t-2$ we have $t=x+2$. Substitution into $y=t^2$ gives $y=(x+2)^2$, with no restriction on real $x$.
